# Anthony Pye

## Overview

- **Gender:** male  <sub>[v2 c1 P45](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0045)</sub>
- **Role:** Student  <sub>[v2 c1 P45](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0045)</sub>

## Appearance

Anthony is a young boy with a dark, sullen little face. He has hostile, black eyes and an impertinent swagger.

_Sources: [v2 c5 P4](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0004), [v2 c12 P1](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0001)_

## Personality

Anthony is sullen, mischievous, and impertinent. He holds female teachers in contempt, believing they are not any good. He obeys authority with a scornful air of toleration and displays mockery and bravado toward his teacher, though he is otherwise not unusually bad.

_Sources: [v2 c5 P4](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0004), [v2 c5 P10](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0010), [v2 c5 P26](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0026), [v2 c7 P5](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0005), [v2 c12 P1](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0001), [v2 c12 P23](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0023)_

## History

Anthony Pye was taken in as an orphan nephew by his aunt, Mrs. George Pye, and began attending school under Anne Shirley. On his early days at school, he poured water down Aurelia Clay's neck from his slate bottle, for which Anne kept him in at recess to lecture him on being a gentleman, though he remained completely untouched. Unlike the other pupils, Anthony openly disliked Anne and held her in contempt because she was a female teacher. He continued to show mockery and disrespect in class, such as strutting impertinently and grinning at her. On one occasion, he watched mockingly as Anne opened her desk drawer to find a mouse that had been placed inside. Anne subsequently punished him with a pointer until tears came to his eyes.

_Sources: [v2 c1 P45](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0045), [v2 c5 P4](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0004), [v2 c5 P10](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0010), [v2 c5 P26](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0026), [v2 c7 P5](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0005), [v2 c12 P1](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0001), [v2 c12 P23](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0023), [v2 c12 P33](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0033)_
